title: Could we survive a year trapped inside a completely sealed indoor biosphere?
angle: Hooking viewers with the claustrophobic stakes of the historic Biosphere 2 failure, this episode reveals the surprising and unsettling ways complex ecosystems rebel against human control when cut off from Earth's atmosphere.
description: An engaging, scientifically accurate exploration of the historic Biosphere 2 experiment, revealing why closed ecosystems rebel against human control and what it teaches us about our fragile relationship with Earth.
